messages:
Srinivas (VP Product): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — we had questions about delivery timelines for three items: 1) API rate-limit tiering changes, 2) Console rerun/debug UI, 3) Optimize suggestion engine (quantization recommendations). Can leads confirm target quarters and any blockers? Thanks.
Ana (PM): Hey — short answers: API tiering: aiming GA end of Q3 (internal beta mid-Q3). Console rerun UI: targeting early Q4 (depends on infra work). Optimize suggestion engine: exploratory prototypes now, pilot in Q4. Will post a timeline doc.
Ken (Eng): For API tiering, main blocker is quota service migration — ETA for infra work is ~2 weeks (after current sprint). If that slips, GA likely slides 3-4 weeks.
Li (DevEx): Will we preserve existing rate-limit headers? We should avoid breaking SDKs.
Ana (PM): Yes — backward-compatible headers in beta. SDK maintainers have been pinged.
Maria (Design): For the Console rerun UI, can we do a quick usability test before beta? I can run 5 sessions next week (remote).
Srinivas (VP Product): That'd be great, Maria. Also, Optimize's quantization recs — do we have privacy/KMS implications for sending model perf traces?
Ken (Eng): For Private deployments, no traces leave customer infra. For Hosted/Dedicated we only collect anonymized perf stats (no raw tokens). Will add a privacy blurb to the doc.
product-docs-bot: New doc uploaded: https://redwood.docs/roadmaps/q3-q4-shipping (draft timelines)
Ana (PM): I'll update that doc with confirmed dates once infra confirms. Plan: start beta invites for API tiering next week.
Li (DevEx): @Ana please add an SDK changelog snippet and migration notes. Example note: ```curl -H 'X-Rate-Limit-Limit: 200' ...```
Ken (Eng): Also flag: autoscaling behavior for Dedicated could change with tiered rate limits. I'll add an infra section and estimate risk.
Ana (PM): Action items — Ken: confirm infra dates by EOD Wed; Maria: schedule 5 usability sessions; Li: prep SDK changelog + migration snippet; I'll update the roadmap doc and ping infra leads. Thanks all :thumbsup: 
Srinivas (VP Product): Appreciate the quick sync. If anyone hits a blocker, post here and I'll escalate.
product-deploy-bot: deploy-log: roadmap-docs update pushed to staging (build 4821)
Ana (PM): Pinged infra leads in separately to unblock Ken. Will follow up in thread with final timeline when I have confirmations.
Li (DevEx): Noted. I'll draft a short "what's changing" email for partners.
Maria (Design): I'll share test notes in the doc after sessions.
Ken (Eng): Confirmed: quota migration sprint scheduled Mon -> Fri next week. If code review goes smoothly we should hit mid-Q3 beta.
Ana (PM): Perfect — updating the doc now. Expect an updated timeline by tomorrow morning.
Srinivas (VP Product): Thanks — closing loop here.
